description: Implementation of Storage Service Request Handler interface for TR-069 host interface, including singleton pattern, message handling, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: StorageSrvcReqHandler
classes.description: Handles storage service requests, singleton pattern, and message processing for TR-069 host interface.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns singleton instance of StorageSrvcReqHandler, creating it if necessary.

methods.description: Initializes the handler; currently always returns true.
